decisions.question: Which approved procedure (title, version, effective date, approving authority) and which Provia workflow version (key, the two Decision action ids, assignees) does this concern? The proposed action briefs in procedure-review.md section 6 cannot be attached to actions until this is known.

Was the urgent case's skip of both approvals authorised by anyone with approval authority, before or after the fact, and was the deviation justified? The two approvers should record ratification or objection on the case now, independently of any procedure change.
decisions.owner: Process owner / policy authority for the procedure

decisions.question: Policy conflict: the request asks to remove both approvals for every case; the approved procedure requires two. Does the policy authority (a) keep the procedure unchanged, (b) add an urgent path with one pre-approval and mandatory ratification (Option A), (c) add a logged emergency override with both approvals collected afterwards (Option B), or (d) withdraw the two-approval requirement? Option (d) was requested and is not recommended; only the policy authority can decide it.

If an urgent path is added (D2 b or c): what is the objective trigger for 'urgent', who may invoke it, and within what period must the deferred approval or ratification be recorded? Not invented; needed before the Exceptions clause of either approval brief can be finalised.

Administrator review of the proposed Agent Memory entry (procedure-review.md section 7): only the standing two-approval rule and the exception-recording rule are proposed; no urgent-path text until D2 is resolved.
